hooks.name: No Auto Push — Review First
hooks.description: Best-effort reminder that intercepts common remote-mutating MCP tool calls (PR/issue creation, merges) so the agent summarizes changes and gets explicit approval first. NOTE: matches MCP tool names only — it does NOT catch `git push`/`gh` run via the shell or raw `gh_rest_api` calls. Durable enforcement is server-side GitHub branch protection on develop/main; see .kiro/steering/autonomy.md.

action.prompt: STOP. Before creating a PR, issue, or merging anything on the remote, you MUST: 1) Summarize ALL changes with file paths and descriptions, 2) Provide an unbiased review noting strengths and concerns, 3) List test results, 4) Ask the user for explicit permission. Do NOT proceed without user approval.
